ModMetaData.name: Shipcracker Warcasket
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description: Adds the Shipcracker warcasket, a late-game boarding armor set for VFE Pirates, welded at the warcasket foundry like any other. The armor's drop thrusters power the Breach Jump, which punches through roofs and walls on landing. With Odyssey you instead get the breach burn in space, an unlimited-range LoS beeline across the map, unburdened by gravity. Odyssey is optional. Compatible with SOS2 and VGE. Requires Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates.
